authorization.authorization_context: Competence run 001 per COMPETENCE_RUN_001.md: ONE bounded development job runs the whole fixed sequence with no separate launches between stages and no two-arm comparison. Single arm (cas framing). STAGE 1 (zero optimizer steps): same-token relationship rewiring must exceed 10x the connection-list-reorder baseline, and the forward/backward sanity must show finite losses with nonzero gradients; failure stops the job with preserved numbers. STAGE 2: bounded training on the familiar train+practice whole-part examples - 64 optimizer steps / 600 s, lr 0.003, learning curve every 8 steps, digest containment (operation:^6 only). STAGE 3 (only if the registered fit criterion is met: mean after-loss < mean before-loss - 0.02): sealed validation/test evaluation with predictions recorded before answers, plus familiar-example accuracy, reported separately. The deliverable is exactly one of LEARNED_AND_TRANSFERRED (criterion met AND sealed >= 6/12), LEARNED_NO_TRANSFER (criterion met, sealed < 6/12), or DID_NOT_FIT (criterion not met; actual losses, predictions, and the measured limitation reported regardless), computed by a deterministic rule. The relationship-preserving problem encoder (option 2), the repaired token lookup, the option path, and the learning scope are as prepared and test-locked (128 graph tests). No silent mid-run patches, no unlimited retries, no spending beyond this single job; the training pilot beyond this run stays pending.

execution_gates: single launch attempt through the competence launcher; bounded readiness checks; verified cleanup on every exit
one new budget reservation exactly once through the canonical budget helper; no refund; no automatic retry
stage 3 reads sealed splits ONLY after the registered fit criterion is met; predictions recorded before answers
only the operation:^6 parameter group may change; the containment report must name any forbidden change
original errors and any completed progress preserved on any failure; evidence persisted on every exit

automatic retry of this or any prior job
any saturation or config change, any allowance change beyond the declared 64 steps / 600 s
